comparison.objective: Candidate fractures insert tangs; record seats four plates and removes/flags any plate that will not sit flat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires impact regulation and fragment recovery; record requires planar seating assessment, exception removal, and peg placement identifying a faulty nest.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures with retained inserts and contained tangs; record requires seated acceptable plates, the rejected plate on a green mat, and a red peg behind the failed nest.
comparison.reason: Fault-aware labware seating and reporting test different contact judgments and outcomes.
